page.content:
Song–Yuan port Marco Polo knew as Zayton.

How Quanzhou connects

  • Location: Maritime silk route — Quanzhou was a chief Chinese port of the maritime silk route.
  • Character: Marco Polo — Polo described the port of Zayton, identified with Quanzhou.

What is Quanzhou?

Quanzhou was the great medieval Chinese terminus of the maritime silk route: Muslim, Tamil, and Chinese merchants under one customs regime, facing the monsoon.

Key threads lead to Maritime silk route and Marco Polo.
